messages:
Jordan (PM): FYI — incoming ask from a large customer (Acme Health) via Priya. They want a streaming chat API that can: partial tokens streamed + support for function calls mid-stream + enforce a strict JSON schema for final structured output. They say this is blocking an integration.
Priya (Support): Customer ticket: https://acme.example/ticket/12345 — they need the ability to get intermediate tokens for real-time UI and still have the system guarantee the final response matches the provided FHIR-adj schema. HIPAA concerns too.
Alex (Sales): They want this for a pilot next quarter. Budget is there if we commit to a delivery window. Main ask: deterministic final schema + low-latency streaming.
Sanjay (Eng Runtime): Quick thoughts — combining streaming + fncall + strict schema is non-trivial. We already stream token deltas, and we have function-calling hooks, but we don't currently provide a post-hoc schema guarantee for the final assembled object while streaming. Two approaches: 1) validate after completion and emit an error/fallback (easiest); 2) support incremental schema enforcement with partial objects and corrective tokens (harder).
Mei (Eng Platform): We should also think about routing policies: Dedicated vs Hosted. Customer is considering Dedicated for compliance, but they asked if hosted can meet latency. We need telemetry for token-level cost, streaming drop rates, and function-call rollbacks.
Carol (Security): HIPAA: data-in-transit and at-rest covered if Dedicated in a VPC + KMS. But we need audit logs for structured outputs and proof of retention policies. Also need to confirm that any schema enforcement does not leak PHI in logs.
Jordan (PM): Proposed scope for intake: 1) Acceptance criteria (must): a) UI can render tokens as they arrive; b) function call triggers can happen mid-stream and responses can be incorporated; c) final output validated against given JSON schema; on validation failure, either auto-correct or produce an explicit validation error with a deterministic retry path. 2) Non-goals: end-to-end transactionality across third-party tools for v1.
Priya (Support): Customer will accept a validation-error fallback if we provide clear semantics and retry patterns. They prefer auto-correct but can compromise.
Sanjay (Eng Runtime): For implementation plan: short-term (MVP): allow streaming tokens + function calls + post-response schema validation + a validation-error envelope. Long-term: token-level schema-aware guidance (model-side) and streaming partial object deltas.
Jordan (PM): Can you estimate effort? Also note this needs new telemetry (validation passes/fails, function-call success, streaming interruptions).
Sanjay (Eng Runtime): Rough T-shirt: MVP ~ 3-4 engineer-weeks (runtime + tests) if we reuse current streaming and function-call plumbing. Platform/ops add ~1-2 weeks for telemetry and rollout gating. Edge-cases (schema auto-correct) add another 3-4 weeks.
Mei (Eng Platform): Rollout plan: feature-flag behind customer entitlement, Dedicated first for pilot, hosted later after compliance sign-off. Need migration docs and config knobs for model variants.
Alex (Sales): We should mark this P1 for the Acme pilot. If we can promise a pilot commit window, they might sign a pilot contract.
Jordan (PM): Decision question for prioritization: Accept as scoped MVP (post-response validation + streaming + fncall wiring + validation-error envelope) and backlog longer-term schema-aware streaming. Who objects?
Carol (Security): Fine with MVP provided logging redact/retention controls are in place and we document compliance constraints.
Priya (Support): Customer ok with MVP flow + clear docs.
Sanjay (Eng Runtime): No technical blockers for MVP; we should add test harness with sample FHIR schemas.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline created for feature branch: feature/stream-fncall-schema (pipeline #4021).
Jordan (PM): Action items: @Sanjay write RFC draft + acceptance tests, @Mei add telemetry plan and rollout gating, @Priya coordinate pilot contract and provide 3 example schemas from Acme, @Carol list compliance checklist. I'll add this to the product backlog as 'api: streaming + fncall + schema-validation (MVP)'.
Alex (Sales): I'll align pilot sign-off timeline with legal.
Sanjay (Eng Runtime): Adding note: PR should include an opt-in header: `X-Redwood-Stream-Schema: strict` and server returns `validation_status` in final envelope. Example final envelope: ```
{
  "final": true,
  "validation_status": "failed",
  "errors": ["missing patient.birthDate"],
  "raw_text": "{...}"
}
```
Jordan (PM): Thanks — this is enough to scope. I'll kick off RFC and prioritization ticket. Keeping this thread for triage notes. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Support): I'll post updates from Acme here as soon as I have them.
Jordan (PM): Closing the intake for now. Will reopen if scope changes.
